subject: Hosted pricing: Velocify monthly tokens & peak concurrency
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex@velocify.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 14:32:00 -0800
Subject: Quick follow-up + one ask (monthly tokens & peak TPS)

Hi Alex — great conversation earlier, thanks for the time. Quick recap and one concrete ask so we can size hosted pricing for the next call: 

Recap (from our call)
- Velocify is planning a customer-facing chat/assistant feature for payments flow and refunds (phase 1) with a follow-on product recommendation engine (phase 2).
- Timing: pilot with ~5K customers in Jan, broader rollout in Q2.
- Key SLOs: 99th percentile latency < 300ms for chat path; ability to sustain short bursts during payroll windows.

Can you confirm two numbers so I can put together tailored hosted-band pricing?
1) Expected average monthly token consumption for the pilot (tokens/month) — ballpark is fine.
2) Peak TPS you need to guarantee during payroll-triggered spikes (99th percentile concurrency/second).

If easier, attach a quick spreadsheet with per-week usage and expected burst cadence. I attached our pricing-band summary for orientation.

Next steps: once you share the two numbers we’ll send a hosted pricing band (3 options: trial, mid, committed) with estimated $/1M tokens and recommended burst guardrails.

Thanks — Rafael

--
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: redwood_pricing_band_summary.pdf (1 page summary)

From: Alex Chen <alex@velocify.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Malhotra <priya.m@velocify.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + one ask (monthly tokens & peak TPS)

Rafael — thanks for the recap. Couple quick answers and I’m attaching a rough usage sheet.

Answers: 
- Pilot (Jan): ~45M tokens/month (chat prompts + short completions).
- Target production (post-rollout): 480M tokens/month by end of Q2 if adoption hits target.
- Peak spikes: payroll windows generate short spikes. We expect peak sustained TPS of ~140 qps for windows lasting 2–5 minutes; 99th percentile sustained for those windows closer to 95 qps.

Attached: velocify_usage_estimate_v1.xlsx — the weekly tabs show expected cadence (weekdays vs payroll-day spikes).

Let us know the diff between the trial and mid tiers on unit price and burst policy.

—Alex

--
Alex Chen
Head of Product | Velocify Labs
alex@velocify.ai
Attachment: velocify_usage_estimate_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 3 sheets)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex@velocify.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 17:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + one ask (monthly tokens & peak TPS)

Alex — perfect, thanks for the spreadsheet. High-level price/ops framing (so you have a baseline before we send formal bands):

- Trial band (no commit): $32 / 1M tokens; soft burst allowed up to +2x baseline for short windows (subject to rate-limit throttling at very high sustained load).
- Mid band (6–12 month expected usage window, light commit): $24 / 1M tokens; recommended burst guardrails + caching suggestions to reduce token count during repeated prompts.
- Committed (contracted monthly commit): $16–18 / 1M tokens depending on guaranteed monthly commit and 99th percentile latency SLO.

Considering your peak numbers (95–140 qps):
- For pilot (45M/mo) trial band likely sufficient; we’ll prioritize responsiveness but expect higher unit costs.
- For production (480M/mo) the committed band materially improves $/1M. We should also discuss dedicated capacity if sustained high TPS with strict SLOs is needed — that’s a different SKU.

Karthik, copied — can you sketch a quick recommended guardrail for the 140 qps short spikes (throttle windows, short-term autoscale, and a recommended KV prefix-caching strategy)?

Alex — I’ll send a formal banded quote and a short ops runbook after Karthik’s note. Any budget target (e.g., target $/1M tokens) you’re trying to hit? That helps me tune the package.

Best — Rafael

--
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_pricing_band_summary.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Chen <alex@velocify.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + one ask (monthly tokens & peak TPS)

Hey Alex — quick ops note from our runtime team (high level):

- For short 2–5 min spikes up to 140 qps we recommend:
  - Autoscale policy with a 60s ramp + short-burst buffer (provision to 2x baseline within 60s).
  - Prefix-based KV caching on repeated prompt contexts (saves 15–30% tokens for repeat flows like payment confirmations).
  - A short, token-aware throttling policy: allow burst up to 2x for <3 minutes, then degrade to 1.2x to protect multi-tenant noisy neighbors.
  - If Velocify needs 99th latency < 300ms during peak, consider Dedicated capacity for payroll windows — we can carve scheduled reserved slots for those hours.

Cost note: with the caching & autoscale mix we typically see effective token reduction in the pilot of ~12–18% which can pull your effective $/1M down vs list pricing.

Will package a 1-page ops-runbook and a committed-pricing band to Rafael for the quote.

—Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions | Redwood Inference

From: Alex Chen <alex@velocify.ai>

Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + one ask (monthly tokens & peak TPS)

Thanks Rafael + Karthik — this is helpful. Quick answers to the budget question:
- Pilot budget: $10–12k / month (we want to limit spend while validating).
- Target production budget: $60–75k / month (depending on $/1M).

Target $/1M: ideally <$20 / 1M once we’re in production; $24 is workable for a mid band if caching can bring effective cost down.

Next steps for us:
1) Rafael — please send the formal banded quote (trial, mid, committed) and include an example month cost table for 45M and 480M tokens (with/without caching uplift).
2) Marissa — can we get a short sample SOW outline for a pilot (2–3 weeks integration + 4 weeks monitoring)?

We’ll review with finance and aim to pick a path before the end of December.

Cheers — Alex

--
Alex Chen
Head of Product | Velocify Labs
